brand.name: AcademyGeo
brand.tagline: Read the road, name the country

landing.title: Every country paints its roads differently.
landing.lede: AcademyGeo drills the clues that never move: plate colours, bollard heads, centre lines, script on signs. Cards you miss come back until they stick.
landing.demoHint: Tap a country to reveal the answer

steps.oneBody: One photo-free illustration of a single static clue, and a clock that starts the moment it lands.
steps.twoBody: Four candidates, drawn from the same region so you have to read the detail rather than the continent.
steps.threeBody: Answer fast and it moves weeks away. Answer wrong and it is back in ten minutes.

landing.catalogueBody: Plates, bollards, road lines, signage script, vegetation and architecture, drawn from every continent.
landing.footer: Built for players who want to stop guessing.
landing.modesBody: Practice keeps you honest over months. These tell you where you stand today, and they all feed the same schedule.

hub.title: How do you want to practise?
hub.subtitle: Five ways into the same deck. Practice keeps you honest over months; the scored runs tell you where you are today.
hub.metaDescription: Untimed spaced repetition practice, plus scored modes: a daily challenge, rush, survival, duel, flash and a run built from your weak spots.
hub.collectionsBody: Bollards, plates, road lines, and the cards that still catch people out.

PRACTICE.name: Practice
PRACTICE.blurb: The spaced repetition session. Cards you miss come back sooner, cards you know come back later, and nothing is scored.

DAILY.name: Daily challenge
DAILY.blurb: The same ten cards for every player, changing at midnight UTC. One attempt, and the board shows how the day went.

RUSH.name: Rush
RUSH.blurb: As many as you can name before the clock runs out. Speed pays, and a run of correct answers pays more.

SURVIVAL.name: Survival
SURVIVAL.blurb: Starts easy and keeps getting harder. Three wrong answers and the run is over, so the last card is always worth the most.

DRILL.name: Weak spots
DRILL.blurb: Built from the countries you actually get wrong. The more you miss Norway, the more Norway you get.

DUEL.name: Duel
DUEL.blurb: One picture, two countries, and they are the two you keep mixing up. No time to reason it through, which is the point.

FLASH.name: Flash
FLASH.blurb: The picture is taken away before you answer, and the look you get shortens with every card you win.
